methods_section.title: 四大功法課程
methods_section.desc: 在修練的動與靜中找尋和諧的步調，用心感受、用身體會，以太極調身心。
methods_section.desc_en: Discover harmony in movement and stillness. Tune your body and mind through Tai Chi.

methods.tag: 內功心法 ． 吐納歸真
methods.title: 華陀導引氣功
methods.quote: 「運先天之炁，化五穀之精，以調身心、延壽命也。」
methods.desc: 又稱五禽戲，模仿熊、虎、鹿、鶴、猿。動作舒緩，包含多種伸展；導引吐納，疏通十二經絡，是身心俱疲的午後放鬆的好選擇。適合長時間久坐、用眼，作息不規律以致入睡困難的族群，氣功提供適當的拉伸及平和的呼吸，所謂氣好、身好、心好，養好氣才會有好力！
methods.desc_en: Also known as the **Five-Animal Play**, this practice mimics the movements of bears, tigers, deer, cranes, and apes. Featuring gentle motions and various stretches, it guides your breathing to unblock the twelve meridians—making it a perfect choice to unwind on an exhausting afternoon. It is ideal for those who sit or stare at screens for long hours, as well as anyone with an irregular schedule having trouble sleeping. Qigong offers just the right balance of gentle stretching and calming breathwork. As the saying goes, clear Qi leads to a healthy body and mind—cultivating your Qi brings vital energy!

methods.tag: 動靜觀心 ． 借力化勁
methods.title: 太極拳
methods.quote: 「動靜相兼，以柔克剛，先化而發，方能以四兩撥千金。」
methods.desc: 不與風爭強，不與水奪流，但借力打力更有勁。別看太極拳看似柔弱不禁、不爭不搶，實則笑裡藏刀、暗藏殺機。除了強身健體的基本功馬步、弓步、後坐步，也有八面玲瓏的防身術折手、斷腳、碎鼻樑。適合只是想輕鬆運動稍微流汗的族群，也適合想學點技巧防身以備不時之需的族群。練拳練好不生煩惱、掤捋擠按惡人退散！
methods.desc_en: Yielding to neither wind nor water, Tai Chi redirects incoming force to strikes with double the power. While it may appear soft and gentle, beneath the calm exterior lies deadly precision. Beyond foundational stances for health—such as the Horse Stance, Bow Stance, and Sitting Stance—it features versatile self-defense techniques that can break an attacker's wrist, leg, or bridge of the nose. It is perfect both for those who simply want a light workout and a good sweat, and for those looking to master practical self-defense skills. Practice well for peace of mind, and master your Tai Chi techniques to keep bad intentions at bay!

methods.tag: 借物修身 ． 身棍合一
methods.title: 太祖棍
methods.quote: 「借物修身，身棍合一。腰、棍、腳俱為一體。」
methods.desc: 太極拳四種古兵器之一，所謂一寸長一寸強，在遠處巧妙化解攻擊也從遠處進攻，產生距離優勢。熟練太極拳之手法、身法、步法後，在赤手空拳的基礎上延伸，學習使用太祖棍，更能感受自己對於腰部發力是否熟練。另外，除了招式動作教學以外，也有招式應用練習，在安全的情況下學員與學員、幹部乃至於老師分組對練。棍子間針鋒相對的鏗鏘，鏗鏘有力不絕於耳！
methods.desc_en: As one of the four ancient weapons of Tai Chi, the long pole proves the saying: "An inch longer, an inch stronger." It allows you to deflect attacks and strike from a distance, giving you a distinct reach advantage. Once you master the hand techniques, body posture, and footwork of Tai Chi, extending your practice to the Taizu Stick will help you refine your waist force and rotational power. Beyond form practice, the course includes practical application through safe sparring sessions—partnering students with peers, leaders, and instructors. Experience the satisfying, rhythmic clashing of sticks as skills clash in action!

methods.tag: 形神俱妙 ． 劍行行雲
methods.title: 太極劍
methods.quote: 「以意御劍，瀟灑飄逸，形神俱妙而不失其防身之效。」
methods.desc: 太極拳四種古兵器之一，所謂劍走輕靈，習劍時不可靠蠻力，需要手腳配合。劍法與拳法息息相關，都強調以柔克剛、重意不重力。劍相較於棍更加變化多端，由於有更多轉向及跳躍，手法、身法、步法顯得至關重要。不過就複習來說，練習劍只要隨手一個摺疊傘、保溫杯，就能夠比劃，比起棍更容易找到替代工具。
methods.desc_en: As one of the four classic Tai Chi weapons, the sword is defined by the saying, "The sword moves with lightness and agility." Learning the sword relies on the coordination of hands and feet rather than brute force. Sword techniques are deeply connected to Tai Chi form, both emphasizing overcoming strength with softness and prioritizing intent over raw power. Compared to the stick, the sword offers far more versatility, making precise hand techniques, body posture, and footwork essential for its frequent turns and jumps. Fortunately, practicing is easy to integrate into daily life—a folded umbrella or a thermos is all you need to rehearse your forms!

experience_section.title: 重要活動大賞
experience_section.desc: 以拳會友，以心相聚。在太極之外，一起探索更多精彩。
experience_section.desc_en: Make Friends Through Tai Chi. Discover More Beyond the Practice.

experiences.title: 初來乍到
experiences.subtitle: 【初體驗及表演欣賞】
experiences.desc: 學期開始的第一堂社課會舉辦迎新活動，新成員在欣賞節目後，可以跟著舊成員的引領，參與小遊戲體驗太極魅力。
experiences.desc_en: To kick off the new semester, we are hosting an orientation event! After enjoying a series of live performances, new members can join in fun mini-games guided by senior members to experience the charm of Tai Chi firsthand.

experiences.title: 心靈手巧
experiences.subtitle: 【傳統春捲DIY】
experiences.desc: 為本社的特色活動，成員們親力親為製作春捲，本地生與外籍生共同體驗傳統文化、享用單純美味。
experiences.desc_en: As a signature event of the Tai Chi Club, members get hands-on in making spring rolls from scratch. Local and international students come together to experience traditional culture and savor simple, delicious flavors.

experiences.title: 寄情山水
experiences.subtitle: 【社團旅遊】
experiences.desc: 社課之餘每學期會有一到兩次社團旅遊，可能是親近自然的踏青活動，又或是造訪附近博物館了解人文歷史，為成員們緊湊的生活安排一個忙裡偷閒的特別行程。
experiences.desc_en: Beyond regular practice, we organize one or two club trips each semester. Whether it’s a refreshing hike in nature or a museum visit to explore local history and culture, it offers a well-deserved break for members to unwind amidst their busy schedules.

experiences.title: 齊聚一堂
experiences.subtitle: 【社團聚餐—素食料理】
experiences.desc: 學期間舉辦一次社團聚餐，所有成員在餐桌上分享交流課程收穫、閒聊一些日常，互相熟絡增進彼此感情。
experiences.desc_en: Once a semester, we gather for a club dinner where all members are welcome! It’s a great opportunity to share our Tai Chi journeys, catch up on campus life, and get to know each other better in a relaxed setting.

experiences.title: 有始有終
experiences.subtitle: 【期末大會成果驗收】
experiences.desc: 在社團的最後一堂課會邀請所有成員在一同表演，不管熟練與否都很歡迎嘗試，不論優劣只希望大家有一個美好的回憶，檢視自己這一個學期的學習成果。
experiences.desc_en: For our final class of the semester, everyone is invited to join in a group performance! Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned practitioner, all are welcome to give it a try. It’s not about perfection or competition—our goal is simply to celebrate your progress over the semester and create unforgettable memories together.

global_section.title: 太極無國界
global_section.desc: 也許語言會築起溝通的牆，但肢體動作不分國界，來自各地的學子，對於學習太極樂此不疲。
global_section.desc_en: Language may build walls between us, but movement knows no borders.

global.subtitle: 外籍生的到訪
global.para1:
政大太極社歷年來接待了無數自歐美、日韓、東南亞等地慕名而來的交換學生。

課程中，我們跨越語言藩籬，以拳會友。五湖四海皆兄弟來者是客，不求依樣畫葫蘆完整學會全套功法，而是希望每位來此的學員，留下珍貴的回憶。
global.para1_en:
Over the years, the NCCU Tai Chi Club has welcomed exchange students from Europe, the Americas, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, and many other parts of the world.

In our classes, we cross language barriers and make friends through Tai Chi. No matter where you come from, you are always welcome here. We hope that everyone who joins us can enjoy the experience and take home some wonderful memories.
global.para2:
隨著越來越多的交換生散佈在世界各地，使我們每次的海外出行都充滿了與眾不同的回憶，而交換生偶爾回台的探訪也無不令我們驚喜萬分。

交換期間的結束只是暫時道別，而絕不會是我們交流的終點。
global.para2_en:
Our friendships continue beyond the exchange. We are always delighted to reconnect with our friends abroad—and to welcome them back when they visit Taiwan.

**The end of an exchange is only a temporary farewell—it is never the end of our friendship.**
global.quote: 「道之所在，雖千萬里，心念若一，自能相逢。」
global.title: 外邦弟子的修真緣分

instructors_section.title: 師資介紹
instructors_section.desc_en: Learn from Masters, Carry the Tradition Forward.

instructors.name: 瞿老師
instructors.subtitle: 基礎班指導老師
instructors.desc:
**華陀導引氣功、太極拳、太極劍教學**     |     教學風格穩健，對於初學者相當友好

曾任元富證券債券部副總經理，在金融界表現優異的瞿老師，原先因忙於工作，導致身體狀況出現警訊，後因長期練習氣功與太極拳而改善健康，連帶於事業的表現上也有所提升，可說是因功法受益的最佳例子。

瞿老師積極推廣太極事業，於台灣傳統武學太極拳刀劍桿散手協會擔任要角，並熱心參與政大太極社與政大EMBA太極拳社交流。亦以太極心法結合職場管理，推廣身心養生，將太極精神充分發揮在生活之中。
instructors.desc_en:
**Huatuo Qigong, Tai Chi & Tai Chi Sword**     |     Steady and beginner-friendly teaching style

Coach Yvonne initially experienced health issues due to the demands of her work. After improving her health through long-term practice of Qigong and Tai Chi, she decided to dedicate herself to promoting both practices.

She believes that Tai Chi is not only a martial art, but also a way to improve physical and mental well-being and bring greater balance to everyday life.

instructors.name: 阿吉老師
instructors.subtitle: 進階班指導老師
instructors.desc:
**進階太極拳、太祖棍教學**     |     擅於將功法與實戰結合，內容扎實

阿吉老師擁有二十餘年的太極拳學習與教學經驗，曾拿下海內外武術比賽的多個獎項。不僅擔任政大太極社的指導老師，亦在企業太極社教學中創造口碑。

阿吉老師整合自己多年學習經驗，對於太極教學有一套自己的方法，並且相當重視同學於動作上的細節是否正確，同學於阿吉老師的指導下練習功法，必定會坐收顯著的功效。
instructors.desc_en:
**Advanced Tai Chi & Taizu Staff**     |     Solid training with a focus on practical applications

With more than 20 years of experience in Tai Chi training and instruction, Teacher A-Ji has received numerous awards in martial arts competitions in Taiwan and abroad. 

His teaching emphasizes precise movements, solid fundamentals, and practical applications, giving students a deeper understanding of how Tai Chi techniques can be applied in real situations.

staff.name: 黃豊文
staff.desc: 本社副社長兼美宣，推陳出新，總有一些創新的點子，是社團裡的開心果。

staff.name: 徐浩倫
staff.desc: 本社前總務變機動長，海納百川，如果要用一個代名詞形容應該是「卡皮巴拉」？

schedule.title: 每週社課/晨練時間
schedule.note: 參加本社活動無門檻限制，本社會提供所需器材，學員僅需穿著寬鬆易活動的服裝出席即可，藝文中心內設有飲水機請自備水壺。歡迎學生、社區居民、社會人士共襄盛舉。
schedule.note_en: Participation in our club activities is open to everyone, with no prerequisites or entry requirements. We provide all the necessary equipment, so participants only need to wear loose, comfortable clothing suitable for movement. There is a water dispenser in the Arts and Culture Center, so please bring your own water bottle.
